series.title: Stargate SG-1
series.description: After Earth’s buried Stargate is reactivated, Colonel Jack O’Neill leads SG-1 through the ancient portal network to worlds across the galaxy. Alongside Samantha Carter, Daniel Jackson and Teal’c, the team searches for allies and technology while fighting the parasitic Goa’uld who enslave human civilizations as gods. Their missions gradually draw Earth into a much larger conflict involving the Tok’ra, Asgard, Replicators, Ancients and, ultimately, the Ori.

series.title: Agent Carter
series.description: In 1946, Strategic Scientific Reserve agent Peggy Carter is sidelined to routine office work after the war while secretly helping fugitive inventor Howard Stark recover stolen weapons with his butler Edwin Jarvis. After clearing Stark’s name, Peggy is sent to Los Angeles, where a frozen-body case exposes Zero Matter, the Council of Nine and scientist-turned-actress Whitney Frost.

series.title: ALF
series.description: After his home planet Melmac is destroyed, Gordon Shumway crash-lands in the suburban garage of the Tanner family, who nickname him ALF and hide him from the government’s Alien Task Force. While Willie, Kate, Lynn and Brian try to keep their impossible houseguest secret, ALF adapts to Earth through television, food, family life and a relentless stream of schemes that repeatedly endanger the very household protecting him.

series.title: Alias Smith and Jones
series.description: Successful outlaws Hannibal Heyes and Kid Curry accept a secret conditional-amnesty deal and try to go straight under the aliases Joshua Smith and Thaddeus Jones. Because their pardon cannot yet be made public, they remain wanted men and must cross the West taking legitimate work, avoiding bounty hunters and resisting the criminal shortcuts they know far too well.
series.collectionScope: Pete Duel as Hannibal Heyes only; later episodes with a different actor playing Heyes are intentionally excluded.

series.title: Andromeda
series.description: Captain Dylan Hunt and the sentient warship Andromeda Ascendant are trapped near a black hole as the Systems Commonwealth collapses. Freed three centuries later by a salvage crew, Dylan recruits its survivors and begins rebuilding the Commonwealth world by world while confronting Nietzschean powers, the Magog World Ship, the Abyss and the deeper mystery of his own survival.

series.title: Atlantis
series.description: After searching for answers about his missing father, modern-day Jason is swept into the legendary city of Atlantis, where he joins Pythagoras and Hercules and becomes entangled with monsters, prophecies and the royal court. His growing bond with Ariadne and conflict with Pasiphae gradually expose the truth about his own origins, turning a succession of mythic adventures into a struggle over the future of Atlantis itself.

series.title: Around the World in 80 Days
series.description: Phileas Fogg accepts a wager that he can circle the globe in eighty days and leaves London with newly hired valet Passepartout and journalist Abigail Fix. Their route becomes a succession of improvised escapes, cultural collisions and personal tests as Fogg discovers that completing the journey demands considerably more than punctual transport connections.

series.title: BeastMaster
series.description: Dar, the last survivor of the Sula tribe, can communicate with animals and roams the Territories with Tao while searching for his lost love Kyra. His bond with the natural world repeatedly draws him into conflicts with rulers, warriors, demons and sorcerers, before a larger mystery surrounding his own heritage takes over the journey.

series.title: Believe
series.description: A gifted young girl named Bo possesses extraordinary abilities that powerful people want to control. Her protectors free Tate, a man imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, and charge him with keeping Bo safe as they flee a well-funded organization determined to capture her.

series.title: Breaking In
series.description: Gifted hacker Cameron Price is blackmailed into joining Contra Security, an eccentric firm that is paid to break into its clients’ systems before real criminals do. Under the unnervingly well-informed Oz, the team turns corporate security testing into elaborate capers while Cameron tries to navigate office loyalties and his feelings for Melanie.

series.title: Brian Cox's Wonders
series.description: Brian Cox uses landscapes, experiments and astronomical observations to explain time, the solar system, the universe, the forces of nature and the histories of other worlds. SceneSense groups the selected BBC science programmes into one continuous collection built around Cox’s evolving exploration of physical reality.
series.collectionScope: Custom Brian Cox science collection grouping Do You Know What Time It Is?, Wonders of the Solar System, Wonders of the Universe, Forces of Nature, The Planets and Solar System into five SceneSense seasons.

series.title: Buck Rogers in the 25th Century
series.editionNote: Twiki uses the alternate voice in this edition.
series.description: Astronaut Buck Rogers is thrown five centuries into the future and awakens on an Earth recovering from catastrophe. His twentieth-century instincts make him an awkward but useful ally of Earth Defense, drawing him into missions involving Princess Ardala, hostile powers and the strange politics of the 25th century.
series.collectionScope: Curated preferred-episode collection from the first-season era only. Omitted broadcast episodes are intentionally excluded rather than retained and marked with M flags.
